We're from Viet Nam!
We are some of the younger members who love animals and pets. 
The place where I live, human life is still difficult, dog meat is considered a popular food, animals are often not paid attention. 
The animals were starved and abandoned.
It is our daily job to find and help them. By getting in touch on social media or by anyone calling us, we will be there.
Everyone, let's love and protect animals, let's live together in peace.
We love you. God will protect us.
Join the group by subscribing to our channel,  and enjoy new videos posted!
Thank you for watching my video.

We are the official, international channel for Asian Pet Rescue Team.
